name: k12-teacher-skills
description: K-12 teacher skills: standards-aligned lesson plans, lesson differentiation, lesson prep, and misconception-based checks for understanding.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, adapt, prepare and check K-12 lessons
interface.longDescription: Four skills for K-12 teachers: create standards-aligned lesson plans with student materials and assessments, adapt an existing lesson for different proficiency levels, prepare to teach a lesson by working its key task, and build misconception-based math checks for understanding.
defaultPrompt: Create a standards-aligned K-12 lesson plan.
Adapt this lesson for students at different proficiency levels.
Create a math check for understanding for this standard.
